i cant understand why people like this game
the game design is heavily flawed in so many ways:
- support role as a whole is insufferable and miserable
- characters are so ugly, graphics are outdated, runs so poorly
- half the hero pool are useless, chen, what is chen
- some of the items are a joke, why would anyone buy revenant brooch when daedalus exists?
- the entire enviorement of the game is toxic, most hero lines, most chat wheels, most voices that are being sold or given for free, everything are there to insult people with
- all the guides including dota plus guides are rigged and sponsored
- matchmaking is an absolute joke
- anti-cheat is none-existent, melonity, umbrella
- each and every single skin ever realeased already has a free mod that you can download and use for free, fashion is dead
- and dont even get me started on the report/ behavior system
-* most importantly, every ranked match takes around 40 god danm minutes...
- and lets not forget that the entire community and the playerbase are under the influence of game design and thus has ended up super duper toxic, bitter and spiteful


honestly the list goes on, i know full well that this post is gonna fall on deaf ears, blind eyes and stupid minds, and i know full well that im just a nobody, but still, none of us can get the time that we spend playing this game back, if we cant enjoy it, might as well quit, there are better games out there

"tis but a fairy tale"

- supports are miserable because the design is flawed, supports need as much as gold as carries, more if not less due to all the wards, carries being sweaty is subjective to the player, while one carry may be chill while min-maxing everything, other may be an absolute sweat lord, the whole "sweaty" aspects stems from the game design, the character look and move, the motion, the sounds, these are beyond the limits of every normal persons understanding, the inferior people if you will, as such, they do get influnced without them even realizing it

- characters are simply horrible, considering where the game have came from, and the dark past that it had, from dota 1 and all the dark art that was related to the original game, things that since then have been removed such as necronomicon, and many more things, you can easily compare dota 2 to other MOBA games out there and you would instantly see how horrible dota 2 looks and runs, an example is a game called smite 2, characters look far better and game runs far better, it doesnt have many of the issues that dota has, another example is something called paragon overprime, or other titles that are out there

- chen was simply an example, in each bracket, only half the hero pool gets constantly chosen while the other half barely get chosen

- revenant brooch is flat useless, its not good for ANY hero, it has far less crit damage compared to daedalus and the damage is based off the total damage, regardless of which hero, role or anything else you play, if you buy daedalus instead, you will deal more damage, not to mention that every character have 25% magic resistance by default, without items, and the total crit rate counts toward any other sources

- people using the game to vent are the issue, thats why therapy exist, thats why many more coping mechanisms exist, get a shower for the love of god, if you are angry, dont take it to other people, go calm down somewhere private, i like watching funny cat videoes, why do people have to vent by harming others???

-guides are meant to be for newbies, people who have no idea about how to play, what to buy, how to level, what to do, and you expect the said player somehow become a veteran and create their own guide, sheer copium from you

- almost everyone know how rigged the matchmaking is, with the 50/50 that was OFFICIALLY confirmed, you are just in deep denial

- anti cheat works fine??? now thats just pure comedy, its beyond the copium or denial level, now you are just trolling

- ive been using skin mods myself, yeah there are many bugs, some skins arent working perfectly, like arcana sets stay in injured mode even when you are above 20% hp, or some arcana sets doesnt heve the move animation, but other than that everything works perfectly

- behavior system is the biggest joke of all times, valve is making so much money that they LITERALLY cannot count, and yet, they are so damn lazy to make a proper report system that validates reports before taking action, its the dumbest thing ever

- i dont know what you are on about, RGC still exists, if you are such a fan of dota 1, go install it and begone

- there is literally not one single match that i can play without someone starting a whole scene, fighting, being passive aggressive or just flat toxic, youre just trolling again

- and i am already much more better than i wish i was, getting better would only make me suffer more from bad teammates, if anything, i wish i was dumber, that way, i wouldnt know what everyone were doing wrong, i would be in BLISS IGNORANCE





overall, youre just in denial
